common.tagline: Grade the notebook, not the screen.

setup.title: Tinta isn't configured yet
setup.body: The app can't reach its database because some environment variables are missing.
setup.steps: Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill in NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, then restart the server. See README → Setup.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Grade your students' paper work with feedback right on the page. You review and approve everything.
login.linkSent: Check your inbox: we sent you a sign-in link. You can close this tab.
login.error: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again in a moment.
login.callbackError: That link expired or was already used. Request a new one.
login.privacyNote: Your students' data is private and is never used to train AI models.

classes.localeHint: You can change it per student later.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your work is saved — please try again.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

assignments.scaleInvalid: Check the scale: maximum must be above minimum and the pass mark must be within it.
assignments.formMatters: The form of the answer matters
assignments.totalPoints: {count, plural, one {# point total} other {# points total}}
assignments.noQuestions: No questions yet. Add one or use a photo of the key.
assignments.snapKeyHint: Photograph the completed key. We extract the questions, answers and points; you confirm each row.

assignments.unconfirmedCount: {count, plural, one {# row still to confirm} other {# rows still to confirm}}

extractErrors.not_configured: AI reading isn't configured on this server. Type the key, or ask whoever runs Tinta to set the API key.
extractErrors.too_large: Up to 4 photos of max 15 MB.
extractErrors.refused: We couldn't read this sheet. Please type the key.
extractErrors.failed: We couldn't read the sheet. Try a sharper photo or type the key.

assignments.rubricHint: A rubric scores the whole work by criteria. You can combine it with questions.

assignments.showScore: Show the score to the student
assignments.previewGlow: You simplified 6/8 to 3/4 correctly in question 1.
assignments.previewGrow: In question 2, when you move the 2 to the other side, change its sign.
assignments.previewNext: Redo question 2 and check your answer by substituting x.
assignments.previewQuestion: What happens to a number's sign when it changes sides?

errors.needs_key: Add at least one question or a rubric.
errors.unconfirmed: Confirm every AI-read row before saving.
errors.save_failed: We couldn't save the assignment. Please try again.

hub.noSubmissions: No work yet. Scan the stack of papers to begin.
hub.duplicateStudent: That student already has work for this assignment.
hub.missing: {count, plural, one {# student missing} other {# students missing}}
hub.noAssignments: No assignments in this class yet.
hub.aiDisclosure: Tinta uses AI to propose grades and comments. Nothing reaches students without your approval.

importErrors.too_many_pages: The PDF has more than 200 pages. Split it in two.
importErrors.unreadable: The PDF couldn't be read. Try exporting it again from the scanner.

pipelineErrors.not_configured: AI grading isn't configured on this server (missing API or OCR key).

pipelineErrors.queue_unavailable: Pages were saved, but the grading queue is unavailable. Please try again.

scan.title: Scan
scan.cameraUnavailable: We couldn't open the camera. You can upload photos instead.
scan.bulkHint: Photos are grouped in order. Tinta will try to read each sheet's name; you confirm it.

quality.blurry: The photo is blurry: move closer and hold still.
quality.glare: There's glare: tilt the phone a little.
quality.too_small: The page looks too small: move closer.

queueErrors.duplicate_student: This student already has work. Choose another or replace it.

scan.offlineNote: Offline: photos stay saved on this device and upload when you reopen Tinta with internet.
scan.batchSummary: {groups, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}} · {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
scan.pdfHint: Scan the whole stack into one PDF. Tinta splits it into students using the QR cover sheets or name stickers; without codes it uses the number of pages below. Up to 200 pages, 50 MB.
scan.pagesPerStudentNoQr: Pages per student (when there are no QR codes)
scan.pdfNeedsOnline: PDF upload needs a connection. Photos still work offline.
scan.pdfStarted: Uploaded. Tinta is splitting it now; students appear on the assignment page as they're found.
scan.pdfError: That PDF couldn't be uploaded. Check it's under 50 MB and try again.

review.addNoteHint: Tap the page where the note should go.
review.deductionNote: Points were taken off — confirm the error is in the work, not in the reading.
review.regenerateHint: E.g. more encouraging, mention the sign error

regenerateErrors.not_configured: AI isn't configured on this server.

review.approveBlocked: {count, plural, one {# flagged item still to check} other {# flagged items still to check}}.

approveErrors.unreviewed: Check the flagged items before approving.
approveErrors.wellbeing: Confirm you've seen the wellbeing notice.
approveErrors.not_ready: This submission isn't ready to approve.

review.wellbeingBody: Something in this work may suggest the student needs support. No automatic comments were made about it. Please follow your school's safeguarding procedures.
review.wellbeingAck: I've seen this and will follow up
review.shortcuts: Shortcuts: J/K submission · ↑/↓ item · 1–9 score · E edit · A approve · T transcription

release.title: Release
release.intro: Release each submission as soon as you approve it. Every student gets their own private link.

release.whatsappText: Hi, here is your marked work for “{title}”: {url}

student.title: Your work
student.disclosure: Your teacher used an AI assistant to review this work, then reviewed and approved these comments.
student.notFound: This link doesn't exist, has expired or was revoked. Ask your teacher for a new one.

qr.coverTitle: Cover sheet — put this on top of the student's pages
qr.coverInstructions: Place this sheet on top of this student's pages before you scan or photograph them. Tinta reads the code, starts a new student and does not grade this sheet. The code contains no name.
qr.title: QR name codes
qr.hint: Print name stickers for worksheets, or one cover sheet per student. Papers with a code are matched automatically.
